title: Count Valid Advertisement Schedules
src: Walmart OA, IIT BHU. Coding question 2 of 3.
body:
An advertising system has n advertisement slots in a row. Each slot shows one of c campaigns. To avoid repetition, the same campaign may appear in at most k consecutive slots.

Two schedules are different if some slot shows a different campaign. Count the valid schedules and return the answer modulo 109 + 7.

Function to complete

Complete countSchedules(n, k, c). It returns the number of valid schedules modulo 10^9 + 7.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
out: One integer: the number of valid schedules modulo 10<sup>9</sup> + 7.

samples.ex: Of the 8 schedules, 111 and 222 show one campaign three times in a row, leaving 6.
Of the 16 schedules, 6 contain a run of 3 or more.

spec.returns: the number of valid schedules modulo 10^9 + 7

wrong.why: O(n*k) dynamic programming: correct but far too slow for n up to 10^9
off-by-one: allows runs of at most k-1 and loops one slot at a time
